job.title: Senior Software Engineer
job.description: As a Senior Software Engineer at Babylist, you will develop systems for a high-volume marketplace, collaborating on advertising, commerce features, and infrastructure while leading projects and improving processes with AI-driven methodologies.
responsibilities: Decide what to build, ship it and own whether it worked.
Frame the problem with PM as a peer.
Run experiments and bring customer evidence into development.
Manage up with crisp choices about risks and tradeoffs.
